from decimal import Decimal, InvalidOperation
from pathlib import Path

input_path = Path("/mnt/data/spreadsheet/399-14/1_399-14_input.xlsx")
output_path = Path("/mnt/data/outputs/399-14_0_a693ac0b/1_399-14_output.xlsx")

ws = wb["Sheet1"]

regular_col = ws["N7"].column
overtime_col = ws["O7"].column
start_row = 7
end_row = 23
threshold = Decimal("40")

for row in range(start_row, end_row + 1):
    cell = ws.cell(row=row, column=regular_col)
    ot_cell = ws.cell(row=row, column=overtime_col)
    value = cell.value

    if value is None or isinstance(value, bool):
        continue

    try:
        hours = Decimal(str(value).strip())
    except (InvalidOperation, AttributeError):
        continue

    if hours > threshold:
        cell.value = int(threshold)
        overtime = hours - threshold
        ot_cell.value = float(overtime) if overtime % 1 else int(overtime)

output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
wb.save(output_path)
